en: Maybe I gotta advertise more, or spruce up my stand or somethin'? I tell ya, I'm stumped!
If only people would try a bite, they'd be hooked, I'm sure.
Ya think so? That's awfully kind of ya to say. Thank you, Haruka-chan!
Hey, if ya ever get a chance, maybe you can talk this place up on TV!
Oh, I don't know. I don't get many chances to say whatever I want on TV...
Ha ha! I was just pullin' your leg. You're an idol, after all. It's not like you're a comedian or anything!
Hey, I know! Wanna be my "manager for a day"? If you'd do that for me, I can't tell ya how much I'd appreciate it!
Manager for a day? What would I do?
Hmm. I dunno. Just stand in front of the shop, maybe? That oughta do the trick!
You really think that'll get customers to buy takoyaki?
Hell yeah it would! I know I'd stop for some takoyaki if a cute idol like you was hawkin' it!
Well, then... How about a handshake event?
I can shake hands with people who buy some takoyaki.
Huh? You'd really do that for me?
Of course! Oh, but wait. I'd better check with my agency to make sure it's all right. I don't think they'll have any objections, though.
It'd be awesome if ya could!
They said yes. They thought it was a great idea to help out a local business.
They did!? That's fantastic! I'll start gettin' ready right away, then!
And I'll change into my work outfit!
Hi! Welcome! Get yer pipin' hot takoyaki here!
(Magutako, huh? Maybe I can tell Tatsuya about this place.)
Thank you kindly! Come again, y'hear?
Ah, well! Buy somethin' next time, y'hear?
Thank you kindly! Come again, hear?
This is my favorite place, see? It's out in the open but still kind of secluded. It's the best.
What'll I have for lunch? Gotta spice things up. Somethin' different every day, y'know?
We're in Osaka. We can't leave without trying their okonomiyaki, am I right?
Nice try. Okonomiyaki is certainly a signature dish, but a real Osakan cognoscenti goes for kushikatsu.
How would you know? This is your first time in Osaka!
I'm stuffed past full. Urp. Osaka's got too many great places to eat, I tell ya.
Whoa! Wow! I can't believe I'm finally seeing this! I'm really here! Woohoo!
Come on! You got enough photos already, don't you?
Dang it, what's taking Takkun? I can't wait to crack open some crab legs.
According to my calculations, the odds of picking up a girl today are... 32 percent!
You did the right thing dumping that jerk. Come on, cheer up. You're better off without him.
Actually, I'm over him. I have two new guys to keep me company.
What!? Two!?
One day, I'm gonna date a cute doll like that.
Doll? You in some kinda noir film? But don't let me discourage ya.
Wow, look! It's a river!
Really? You don't watch Princess League? You just have to! Haruka-chan is gonna be huge, you watch! She's got talent and cuteness in spades!
I haven't been watching TV much at all.
Please! I'll buy ya some Magutako takoyaki. Just don't tell Ma, all right? Come on, son!
Are you kiddin'? I can't tell Mama. I can't tell anyone you had those kinds of videos, Pop! Makes me wanna throw up.
Every day's the same. I'm bored, bored, bored. Ain't there any excitement to be had?
Today's a good day! I can't lose, even when I try! Wahaha!
T-Set's the duo to watch. Their prissy bitchiness will make them stars!
Hmm... Coffee? Or tea? Life is one decision after another.
Let's see... Where's "How to Become a Can-Do Gal"? Don't they have it in stock yet?
I hate everything! The president reamed me, the old lady's cooking is a biohazard, and it's frickin' cold again! Get me outta here!
Oh, cheer up, boss. We'll chug a couple beers and piss away our worries. Sound good?
Going on a date. Waiting for my girl now.
I'm gonna do it! I'm gonna clean myself up and get me a job.
Yes, Kiyohiko! I'm so glad you're finally getting it together. Is there anything I can do to help?
Huh? Well, at least a suit, shirt, tie, shoes, and a briefcase to start. I need all that for interviews, right?
No doubt, y'know? It's all about Ginji and Hidemaru.
Yeah, for sure. Still, I think Hidemaru can be top for a change, can't he?
No way! You're sayin' Ginji's a bottom? Like that'll happen! Wake up, girl!
You're no man if ya don't go for it now. C'mon, man up! Be a man!
No, I'm gonna pass. Let's go back to the hotel.
Gotta line up again tomorrow morning. Choosin' the right pachinko machine's half the battle!
That was delicious! Where are we going next?
We did okonomiyaki, kushikatsu... Oh! We need to do takoyaki! We still have a lot of Osaka to eat through.
Bored and free. Someone play with me... And... post to timeline.
Ugh. Of course the guy to respond immediately is the class creep.
A couple of trucks crashed. But no one's hurt, by the look of things.
Help! Someone call the police!
(The police are comin'. Better make myself scarce.)
Roooar!
What the⑬!
Oh, my gosh! Bear! A bear came out of the truck!
It's a bear from the zoo! Everyone run! Call the police!
Bear! Everyone, move! Run!
Someone...
Hey! Over here!
This one's like a teddy bear compared to Yama-oroshi.
Hey, you! Get away! What are you thinking?
You...
Heh, bring it on. I don't mind ya!
Bookstores are great. Just browsin' puts a little bounce in my step.
So archaic and inefficient. Just get yourself an e-reader. You can download anything you want to read without leaving home.
It's convenient, all right. But it's missin' something called soul, and I don't think you can send that over the tubes.
The air's so damn dry it drives me nuts. This day and age, a guy has to take care of his skin.
All right! I'm gonna ask Sanae-chan out. No one can stamp out this fiery passion of mine!
Actually, well, Sanae and me, we're... Uh, never mind.
I can't. I dunno any new songs that are popular nowadays. You guys go on to karaoke without me.
Come on, it'll be okay! They're all lookin' forward to seein' ya.
Urp! *hic* Had a couple too many drinks. The doctor says I shouldn't, but fuggem.
We're takin' the town tonight! We are shotgunnin' beers till the cows come home! Ride along, deputy!
Uh, but boss... I think we have a meeting first thing tomorrow...
So, you said there's gonna be babes by the busload tonight, huh? Oh, I can't wait!
Yeah, uh-huh, we just got here. What!? They couldn't make it!?
I see people dancin' around on the street a lot these days. What the heck's that about?
You and me, let's square off in a dance battle! Heh, just jokin'. That's like the "in" thing now, ain't it?
Ya know how static electricity can zap ya when you open a door, say? You can avoid gettin' zapped by grabbin' the door handle real quick.
Didja hear? There's a new moneylender in town. People say they make loans with no interest!
No way! That's gonzo. Like, off the rails! I'll take 300 million yen, then!
She's never gonna notice me anyway. My feelings aren't gonna reach her no matter how I yearn.
That's defeatist thinkin'. If ya don't have a dream, it can't come true. Hold onto your dream. Maybe one day, ya know?
Ya think!? That rekindles my hope, man. One of these days, Haruka Sawamura-chan's gonna notice me!
Wait, you're in love with an idol!?
Please, please, please, make me handsome. Make me handsome. Oh, please...
I got rejected on another job interview. It's my tenth in a row. Maybe I'm just not cut out for this whole employment thing.
I heard my doorbell, so I answered the door right away... but there was no one there. It had to have been a ghost.
Don't be silly. You just imagined it. Or it's just electrical trouble.
Let's ride the Ferris wheel! It would be the perfect end to our date.
Not happening. Look how high it is! I'll wait for you down here if you want.
Yeah! Work's finally done. Tonight, I shall party all night in the park!
Don't worry about the last train. You can stay at my place.
No, I should go. I'm not feeling all that well tonight.
You always say that! What is wrong with you?
You can't tell me what to do! Who can go without a drink, I ask you? In this day and age!? Who!?
You're never on time. Have you ever come when you said you would?
I'm sorry! I was so excited about seeing you, I couldn't fall asleep, and then I overslept!
It's so cold. Today's the sort of day when hot meat buns really hit the spot.
Come on, let's go here next!
Nah, I'm tapped out. I blew the last of my spending money already. I'm done for the rest of the month.
I'm not letting you go home tonight. And I'm not letting you sleep either!
Oh, yes, please!
I knew this place would be full of couples this time of year, but... Dammit! I'm so jealous!
I think I lost my way. It's kind of scary walking around here by myself.
Can't you decide yet? I'm starvin'!
Hold on! I'm searchin' review sites for places that are rated highly but aren't too expensive. Just hold your horses.
Look, even a burger will do now!
I can't stop coughing. *cough* Was it because I didn't wash my hands or gargle when I got home yesterday?
We might not be able to go out to eat much once I get married.
Oh, don't say that! That would be terrible. Can you maybe break your engagement and marry me instead?
Haha. That's an option.
Smokers are your modern-day pariahs. It's our own damned fault, too. There are too many ill-mannered dolts who ruin our reputation.
What's there to worry about when we got massage parlors? Take a load off, get your rocks off. How would guys live without 'em?
I want to leave everything behind and go off to Okinawa. That's paradise!
Sounds good. I'll book time off this summer.
What are you sayin'? I'm going this weekend.
People put kids down for being immature, but it's those new and immature ideas that are going to shape the future. That's what I think.
Feelin' lucky? How 'bout a game of cho-han? Wait a sec,  you ain't got no chips. Go buy some at the front, then come see me.
How about some cho-han? Feel like a game today?
Well, all right. I hope you'll play next time!
Whaddaya wanna know?
Cho-han is a gambling game where players predict whether the total value of two dice rolls will end up odd or even.
The payout is based on how much you and the other players wagered.

You can bet on what number will show on one of the two dice.
If you guess right, you can earn even more chips by simply guessing odd or even.

You can also bet on which numbers will show on both dice.
If you guess right, you get all of the money in the current pot.

When playing against the house, you will guess either odd or even. Guess right, and you win twice the amount of chips you bet.
You can roll up to five times.
Some of the other players might be on a roll. Others may be on a terrible losing streak, or having just average luck.
If you can identify who has a hot hand, you can tag along with your bets. However, luck never holds⑬a steady winner may suddenly turn stone cold.
Hey, now. If you want to play <Color:8>cee-lo<Color:Default>, you'll be needing more wooden tags.
The minimum bet is ten tags. You can play after you buy some more wooden tags.
How about some <Color:8>cee-lo<Color:Default>? Can I interest you in a game?
Uncle Kaz! See if you can <Color:8>win 1,000 points or more at cee-lo<Color:Default>. I like seeing you win.
(Haruka wants me to <Color:8>win 1,000 points or more at cee-lo<Color:Default>.)
No? Roll with us some other time, then.
Yeah? You're in?
Come on over here then.
No? Another time, then.
Come on over here, then.
Having ice cream while toasty in a kotatsu... That's decadence you can only enjoy in winter.
I know exactly where you're comin' from. There's a sense of guilty pleasure that makes it even sweeter.
One of these days, we're gonna speed around in a flashy, roarin' muscle car, babe.
If we're going to get married and have kids, a minivan's the ideal choice. We want a boy and a girl, right?
That dress will look good on you. Get your boyfriend to buy it!
You think so? But I can't expect him to come up with this kind of money. Maybe I'll ask sugar daddy number three...
Three? Wow, you're something else.
Change your mind, Suzuki-san? Come on, let's go out and do some sea fishing.
That could be fun. I'm up for some fishing as long as you've got room. Can you spare a fishing rod and some bait?
You got <Color:8>Mentaiko Bun<Color:Default>.
Whoops. I've got three pieces of bait to give you, but it doesn't look like you have space for them.
